scope.productionBaseline: /workspace/scratch/de82858a41ec/blog-audit/production-baseline.json (all 41 guide URLs HTTP 200, one H1, generic hero description present)

globalFindings.finding: All 41 guide pages pass PremiumIntentHero the same title-derived description template; metadata descriptions vary, but visible hero copy is generic and does not answer guide intent.
globalFindings.action: Use guide-specific opening copy derived from g.intro/decision, capped to a concise above-fold answer.

globalFindings.finding: Only 3 guides have slug-owned hero art. The remaining 38 reuse broad category or neutral images; one route is misrouted by substring matching date inside dated.
globalFindings.evidence: guideHero() and reuse counts in every row
globalFindings.action: Resolve art by slug/brief, record rights and depicted subject, and replace generic or mismatched imagery.

globalFindings.finding: The /guides hub groups all records but renders only four hard-coded regions, so 16 of 41 guides are omitted from crawlable hub links.
globalFindings.action: Use data-driven region ordering and render every guide once.

globalFindings.finding: Every guide visibly says Written by the Wayfind team, led by Gabriel Pereira and emits Gabriel Pereira as Article author JSON-LD. The repository does not establish a per-guide visit record or expanded biography.
globalFindings.action: Use truthful author/methodology copy and date labels; treat visit and credential claims as unchecked.

globalFindings.finding: Only the Halloween food and Fall Events data modules carry an explicit sources array. Other guides have no in-data source register, so claims need factual recheck before premium publication.
globalFindings.action: Add source/evidence records or mark each recommendation pending verification.

globalFindings.finding: Only Orlando Halloween Food has pick-level inline visuals (23 editorial visualizations); the other 40 guides have no inline image evidence.
globalFindings.action: Add relevant licensed/original inline art selectively, with alt text, credits, and disclosure where illustrative.

globalFindings.finding: Ten summer-2026 guide modules carry an explicit 2026-08-30 sunset, already past audit date 2026-09-09.
globalFindings.action: Remove, redirect, or refresh all ten before treating portfolio as publish-ready.

globalFindings.finding: All 19 title-count guides have matching pick counts; title years, acreage, and distance are excluded from count checks.
globalFindings.action: Retain as a guard while changing titles or pick lists.

globalFindings.finding: All resolver and inline image paths referenced by the 41 guide records resolve under public/.
globalFindings.action: Keep asset existence check in release QA; rights and visual relevance remain separate checks.

guidesHub.note: The regions object receives all omitted regions, but JSX maps only the four-item order array.
